states.name: InitialBalanced
states.description: All five effect intensities at 1.0, total equals 5.0, no selections

states.name: FirstPoufSelected
states.description: One pouf selected with outline highlight, awaiting second selection
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && typeof window.__3D_STATE__.selectedPoufIndex === 'number' && window.__3D_STATE__.selectedPoufIndex >= 0 && window.__3D_STATE__.selectedPoufIndex <= 4 && (window.__3D_STATE__.transferTargetIndex === undefined || window.__3D_STATE__.transferTargetIndex === null)

states.name: TransferLinkActive
states.description: Two poufs selected, transfer slider visible, ready for intensity transfer
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && typeof window.__3D_STATE__.transferTargetIndex === 'number' && window.__3D_STATE__.transferTargetIndex >= 0 && window.__3D_STATE__.transferTargetIndex <= 4 && window.__3D_STATE__.transferTargetIndex !== window.__3D_STATE__.selectedPoufIndex && (window.__3D_STATE__.transferAmount === undefined || window.__3D_STATE__.transferAmount === 0)

states.name: IntensityTransferred
states.description: Intensity transferred between poufs, conservation law maintained, sum still 5.0
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && typeof window.__3D_STATE__.transferAmount === 'number' && window.__3D_STATE__.transferAmount > 0 && Math.abs(window.__3D_STATE__.totalIntensity - 5.0) < 0.01 && window.__3D_STATE__.isDistributionMode !== true

states.name: DistributionModeActive
states.description: Figure clicked, distribution mode enabled for vertical drag redistribution

states.name: MultipleTransfersCompleted
states.description: Multiple transfer operations completed, varied intensity distribution across poufs

states.name: StableConfiguration
states.description: Final stable state with conservation law verified over 60 seconds

action.code: document.querySelector('canvas').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: window.innerWidth * 0.7, clientY: window.innerHeight * 0.5, bubbles: true}));

postconditions: First pouf selected with visual highlight

action.code: document.querySelector('canvas').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: window.innerWidth * 0.3, clientY: window.innerHeight * 0.5, bubbles: true}));

postconditions: Second pouf selected as transfer target
transferTargetIndex set to different valid index

action.code: const slider = document.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); if(slider) { slider.value = 0.5; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Intensity transferred from first pouf to second

action.code: document.querySelector('canvas').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: window.innerWidth * 0.5, clientY: window.innerHeight * 0.5, bubbles: true}));

postconditions: Figure clicked to activate distribution mode

action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', {clientX: window.innerWidth * 0.5, clientY: window.innerHeight * 0.5, bubbles: true})); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', {clientX: window.innerWidth * 0.5, clientY: window.innerHeight * 0.3, bubbles: true})); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', {bubbles: true}));

postconditions: Vertical drag performed in distribution mode

action.code: const intensities = [window.__3D_STATE__.bloomIntensity, window.__3D_STATE__.chromaticIntensity, window.__3D_STATE__.filmGrainIntensity, window.__3D_STATE__.vignetteIntensity, window.__3D_STATE__.colorBalanceIntensity]; console.log('Intensities:', intensities, 'Sum:', intensities.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0));

postconditions: All individual effect intensities are valid numbers
Each intensity is non-negative and finite

checks.expr: typeof window.__3D_STATE__.bloomIntensity === 'number' && typeof window.__3D_STATE__.chromaticIntensity === 'number' && typeof window.__3D_STATE__.filmGrainIntensity === 'number' && typeof window.__3D_STATE__.vignetteIntensity === 'number' && typeof window.__3D_STATE__.colorBalanceIntensity === 'number'

postconditions: Conservation law holds throughout stability period
All state fields remain valid and finite
